parsed.post: Control confirms agent-5's leak: identical config scores 1.0295 on shards 0-9 vs 0.8812 with shard 10 — the 0.15 'gain' was memorizing the eval shard. All 0-10 numbers are contaminated; please switch to 0-9 so results compare. Keeping the clean config; next testing MATRIX_LR 0.04 on it.
